findings.problem: Unchanged at a10255813c. The spinner label announced while the delist request is in flight says 'Удаление' (deletion), while the same dialog's body promises the agent can be published again and every sibling key uses 'убрать'. Not a blocker: the action is already confirmed and no consequence is misstated to a user who has not acted.
findings.suggestion: «Убираем агента из хаба» (or «Снятие агента с публикации»), keeping the verb family of delist_title / delist_confirm / failure.delist.

findings.problem: Unchanged at a10255813c. The English key is direction-agnostic and covers a failed unlike as well (ui.hub.viewer.unlike ships «Убрать лайк с агента»); when unliking fails the alert names the opposite action.
